description: This file contains statistical functions for SparkDataFrames, including methods for crosstab, covariance, correlation, frequent item detection, quantile approximation, and stratified sampling.

classes.name: jobj
classes.description: Set OldClass for Java object reference

methods.name: crosstab
methods.description: Computes a contingency table for two columns in a SparkDataFrame.

methods.name: cov
methods.description: Calculates the sample covariance between two numerical columns in a SparkDataFrame.

methods.name: corr
methods.description: Calculates the Pearson correlation coefficient between two columns.

methods.name: freqItems
methods.description: Finds frequent items in specified columns of a SparkDataFrame.

methods.name: approxQuantile
methods.description: Computes approximate quantiles for numerical columns.

methods.name: sampleBy
methods.description: Returns a stratified sample without replacement based on specified fractions.
